image_description: A side-profile view of a large, dark brown bison standing in a dry, grassy field. The animal exhibits the characteristic massive shoulder hump and shaggy forequarters. A second bison is partially visible lying down in the background behind the main subject's legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile, showing a broad shape and short, curved horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct long, shaggy hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the 'beard' description.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head.
One ear is visible; it is small and surrounded by thick fur, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal displays significant mass and height at the shoulders, typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, dark, shaggy fur that creates a distinct hump at the shoulders.
The fur on the rear half of the body appears shorter and smoother compared to the dense mane on the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visibly short relative to the massive size of the head and body.
The lower legs and feet are obscured by tall, dry grass, making it impossible to verify the presence or structure of cloven hooves.
The tail is visible hanging down, appearing short with a darker, bushy end.

artifact_observations.location: Fur on the flank and hindquarters
artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the fur on the mid-section and rear lacks fine strand detail, appearing slightly smudged or painterly compared to the sharper definition on the head and shoulder hump. This suggests minor generative smoothing.

There is a greyish, amorphous shape behind the bison's front legs (likely another bison lying down). Its boundaries are indistinct and it blends unnaturally into the ground and the main subject's legs, indicating a failure in object separation/depth.
